description.text: Core courses Inorganic Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Physical Chemistry, Instrument Analysis, Structural Chemistry, Chemical Engineering Foundation, Theory of Chemical Teaching, etc. Objective This objective is to train students to be high-qualified professional personnel, working in the institutions of higher learning, research institutions, middle schools, environmental protection departments or other chemistry-related sectors to teach, research or be engaged in management affairs. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Science is granted.

duration.text: The Electronic Information Engineering at Sichuan Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/In total ￥ 15000 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Certification of no criminal record 8.Copy of insurance policy 9.Photocopies of personal artwork Those who apply for artistic major should supply materials to prove your art level.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduates 2.No criminal record 3.HSK level 3 or above
